This '''factory''' was located on an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Unidentified Outer Rim planet (Separatist factory)|planet]] controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this factory was [[Raid on a Separatist factory|raided]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in an attempt to steal an encrypted file held on a [[Datachip/Legends|data chip]], one crucial to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]' war effort. The encrypted file contained the plans of a [[Updated battle droid|new model]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was designed in an intent to replace the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].<ref name="Update" />
